top_signal.title: Spinning out, new mom, entrepreneur-wannabe
top_signal.summary: My daughter is 7 months old and much to my surprise I no longer want to be a working mom. I never planned to stop working but absolutely everything changed when I became a mom.    I would love to have my own business, something with flexibility that allows me to be a mom. I’ve been fighting, literally since she was a week old trying to get a consultancy business going.    I am a Product Manager in the corporate world and I have history working with a range of businesses, large institutions to small mom and pops, helping them understand complicated problems and designing tech solutions.    The one problem I’m failing to solve currently? How do I get clients? Do small businesses need someone like me? The most obvious is leveraging my existing network, and … that has not translated. Lots of well wishes, good intentions and the like, just…. Crickets.    I’ve done some free work for testimonials.    It destroys me how little I see my kid. I can’t afford to fail at this because the cost is missing her childhood.    Any advice? I’m eternally grateful for any direction.        submitted by     /u/CoachBinca       [link]       [comments]
